body.zh: 找不到任何 L 让数列趋于它，数列就发散。(−1)ⁿ 从不跑远，仍然发散：不管 L 取几，ε 取 1/2，N 总被往后推。
body.en: A sequence diverges when there is no L it tends to. (−1)ⁿ never wanders off and still diverges: whatever L is, with ε = 1/2, N keeps being pushed back.

body.zh: 无穷多项 a₀ + a₁ + … 相加的值，定义为部分和 Sₙ 的极限。部分和有极限，就说级数收敛，那个极限就是它的和：1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … = 2。
body.en: The value of a₀ + a₁ + … with infinitely many terms is defined as the limit of the partial sums Sₙ. When that limit exists the series converges, and the limit is its sum: 1 + 1/2 + 1/4 + … = 2.

body.zh: 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + …：每一项都趋于 0，部分和却越过任何界，所以发散。它长得极慢，前一百项的和才约 5.19。
body.en: 1 + 1/2 + 1/3 + …: its terms tend to 0, yet its partial sums pass every bound, so it diverges. It grows extremely slowly: the first hundred terms add up to only about 5.19.

body.zh: 所以项趋于 0 只是级数收敛的必要条件，不是充分条件。
body.en: So terms tending to 0 is necessary for a series to converge, not sufficient.

body.zh: e = 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + 1/3! + … ≈ 2.718281828。阶乘长得极快，这个级数几项就准到小数点后好几位。
body.en: e = 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + 1/3! + … ≈ 2.718281828. Factorials grow so fast that a few terms are right to several decimal places.

body.zh: xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2 从任意正数起趋于 √c：猜得大了，c/xₙ 就小了，平均两者。误差每步大约平方一次，有效数字一步翻一倍。
body.en: xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2 tends to √c from any positive start: if a guess is too large, c/xₙ is too small, and the average takes both. The error roughly squares each step, doubling the correct digits.

body.zh: 它是牛顿法用在 x² − c = 0 上的一个特例。
body.en: It is Newton’s method applied to x² − c = 0.

value.zh: 1/(n+1) 每一项都不是 0，却能小过任何给定的正数：这样的数列叫<wiki-ref to="infinitesimal"></wiki-ref>。
value.en: No term of 1/(n+1) is 0, yet it gets smaller than any positive number named: such a sequence is an <wiki-ref to="infinitesimal"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: 真假写成 1 和 0，乘上去就能挑选：<wiki-ref to="inequality"></wiki-ref>也成了算术。
value.en: Truth written as 1 and 0 picks by multiplying: <wiki-ref to="inequality"></wiki-ref> has become arithmetic.

value.zh: |a − b| 叫两数的<wiki-ref to="distance"></wiki-ref>：只量隔多远，不看谁在左边。
value.en: |a − b| is the <wiki-ref to="distance"></wiki-ref> between two numbers: how far apart, never which is on the left.

value.zh: 离 L 不到 ε 的数，叫 L 的 ε <wiki-ref to="neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>。
value.en: The numbers less than ε from L are L’s ε-<wiki-ref to="neighbourhood"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: 一件事可以<wiki-ref to="eventually"></wiki-ref>一直成立，前面有几项不成立也不要紧。
value.en: Something can hold <wiki-ref to="eventually"></wiki-ref>, whatever the terms before it did.

value.zh: 不管 ε 多小，总有一项 N，从它起每一项都离 L 不到 ε：L 就是数列的<wiki-ref to="limit"></wiki-ref>。只跑了有限拍，N 只在这些拍以内成立。
value.en: However small ε is, some term N has every term from it on less than ε from L: L is the sequence’s <wiki-ref to="limit"></wiki-ref>. Only finitely many ticks ran, so N holds within them only.

value.zh: 不管 L 取几，总有某个 ε 让 N 一直被往后推：找不到它趋于的数，这样的数列<wiki-ref to="divergence"></wiki-ref>。
value.en: Whatever L is, some ε keeps pushing N later: there is no number it tends to. This is <wiki-ref to="divergence"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: 部分和有极限，就说<wiki-ref to="series"></wiki-ref>，和就是这个极限。
value.en: When the partial sums have a limit, it is a <wiki-ref to="series"></wiki-ref>, and the limit is its sum.

value.zh: 项趋于 0，和仍越过任何界：<wiki-ref to="harmonic"></wiki-ref>发散。项趋于 0 只是级数收敛的必要条件。
value.en: The terms tend to 0, yet the sum passes every bound: the <wiki-ref to="harmonic"></wiki-ref> diverges. Terms tending to 0 is only necessary for convergence.

value.zh: 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + … 趋于<wiki-ref to="e"></wiki-ref> ≈ 2.71828：阶乘长得飞快，几项就准到小数点后好几位。
value.en: 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + … tends to <wiki-ref to="e"></wiki-ref> ≈ 2.71828: factorials grow so fast that a few terms are right to several decimal places.

value.zh: xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2 从任何正数起都趋于 √c，这就是<wiki-ref to="babylonian"></wiki-ref>。
value.en: xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2 tends to √c from any positive start: this is the <wiki-ref to="babylonian"></wiki-ref>.

value.zh: xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2 从任何正数起都趋于 √c，这就是巴比伦开方。
value.en: xₙ₊₁ = (xₙ + c/xₙ)/2 tends to √c from any positive start: this is the Babylonian square root.

value.zh: 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + … 趋于 e ≈ 2.71828：阶乘长得飞快，几项就准到小数点后好几位。
value.en: 1 + 1/1! + 1/2! + … tends to e ≈ 2.71828: factorials grow so fast that a few terms are right to several decimal places.

value.zh: 项趋于 0，和仍然越过任何界：调和级数发散。项趋于 0 只是级数收敛的必要条件。
value.en: The terms tend to 0 and the sum still passes every bound: the harmonic series diverges. Terms tending to 0 is only a necessary condition for convergence.

value.zh: 无穷多项相加的值，就是部分和的极限：这样的级数叫收敛。
value.en: The value of infinitely many terms added is the limit of the partial sums: such a series converges.

value.zh: 不管 L 取几，总有某个 ε 让 N 一直被往后推：找不到它趋于的数，这样的数列叫发散。
value.en: Whatever L is, some ε keeps pushing N later: there is no number it tends to, and such a sequence diverges.

value.zh: 不管 ε 多小，总有一项 N，从它起每一项都离 L 不到 ε：这就是数列趋于 L。这里只跑了有限拍，N 只在这些拍以内成立。
value.en: However small ε is, there is a term N from which every term is less than ε from L: that is what tending to L means. Only finitely many ticks ran here, so N holds within them only.

value.zh: 一件事从某一项起一直成立，前面有几项不成立也不要紧。
value.en: Something can hold from some term on, whatever the terms before it did.

value.zh: 离 L 不到 ε 的数，叫 L 的 ε 邻域。
value.en: The numbers less than ε from L are L’s ε-neighbourhood.

value.zh: |a − b| 只量隔多远，不看谁在左边。
value.en: |a − b| measures only how far apart, never which is on the left.

value.zh: 真假写成 1 和 0，乘上去就能挑选：比较也成了算术。
value.en: Truth written as 1 and 0 picks by multiplying: comparison has become arithmetic.

value.zh: 1/(n+1) 每一项都不是 0，却能小过任何给定的正数。
value.en: No term of 1/(n+1) is 0, yet it gets smaller than any positive number you name.

value.zh: 只会加和乘的机器，一拍算出数列的一项。亲手接出求和与差分，看它们互相撤销；再把「越来越近」拼成电路，判断一个数列、一个级数究竟趋于什么。
value.en: A machine that can only add and multiply computes a term of a sequence each tick. Wire up summing and differencing and watch them undo each other; then wire “getting closer” itself, and judge what a sequence or a series really tends to.

value.zh: 只会加和乘的机器，一拍算出数列的一项。亲手接出计数、求和与差分，看它们互相撤销；这一对就是微积分的两半。
value.en: A machine that can only add and multiply computes a term of a sequence each tick. Wire up counting, summing and differencing yourself and watch them undo each other: the two halves of calculus.

why: 摆动关只查 N，去掉正负交替的板（1/(n+1)）也能通过：变异审计查出（drop h）。加上交出 aₙ，测试才区分摆动与不摆动。

ops.zh: 交出 aₙ = (−1)ⁿ/(n + 1)；测试给出 ε，交出它离 0 不到 ε 的 N。
ops.en: Give aₙ = (−1)ⁿ/(n + 1); the test gives ε: give the N at which it comes within ε of 0.

ops.text:
g = reg[reg=A, start=1]()
k = const[value=-1]()
h = mul(g, k)
w = keep[reg=A](h)
n = count()
o = const[value=1]()
m = add(n, o)
r = recip(m)
t = mul(g, r)
z = const[value=0]()
x = near(t, z, e)
s = since(x)
a <- t
N <- s
